title: The Year Nobody Names

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The yard goes around its places and calls the weather weather. A year comes round to the month it started in and no hand turns it over to see what it cost. What the basket keeps it keeps without a name, and the house goes on counting its days in loaves.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, at the turning of the deep-winter month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and sixty-six to three hundred and sixty-eight days, six months and one hundred and eighty-six to one hundred and eighty-eight days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: as in chapters 25 through 104 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. The register takes the body each morning in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire, and that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the careful rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. The chapter's whole subject is a first birthday in this life that nobody under any roof names: no party, no cake, no figure, no recognition, no line crossed. Stone 7 (Day 366) is the day he was born into Sarn a year before; the boy keeps three hundred and sixty-six, three hundred and sixty-seven and three hundred and sixty-eight exactly, six months and one hundred and eighty-six through one hundred and eighty-eight days told by nobody, and three hundred and sixty-six is a whole year stood edge to edge in the only keeping that is exact — a round number in the old register only, a date named to nobody, neither a threshold crossed nor a thing anybody speaks. The carried fire keeps four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed 366, 367 and 368 days; the boards keep four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot; Garl's name stays unspoken the same three numbers; the river that went under its winter skin on Stone 1 is found where put and not made again, not spent on the birthday or on the Hearth Drawing of Stone 12 three mornings beyond the close. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among, the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, with the seventh place empty; answers 307 through 312 are filed on the sixth place, bringing the honest answers there to three hundred and twelve, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine. Seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule with the widow's mark touched only before the kiln on Stone 5 and at no other hour and no eighth made due, a birthday not being an opening; setting-down-wrong-and-swept-around stays gathered once beside the premature note of Smoke 14; nine arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked and unread in Berr Clay's box up the clay road and the figure read still not the figure paid; Ilva's ninth record-first hand stays in her sleeve offstage and Hessa's eighth stays on the road offstage with no tenth; nine stoppings keep no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan stands uncalled; the promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn and he's not Vail stays sealed.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{366}{Stone 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary tending day, no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road and no runner on any road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva this morning. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Stone 4, 5 or 6 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the first firing stands behind the household without a lesson, the seventh opening is seven in seven months and not a rule with no eighth made due, the setting-down-wrong stays gathered once on its own place beside the premature note of Smoke 14, and the river's skin stays on its own place beside water-over-water and is not spent on this day. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 306 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap. **This scene carries the chapter's one meaningful change (T071/T072 with T088, advanced and NOT paid):** the count goes 365 to 366 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-five to one hundred and eighty-six days told by nobody, and three hundred and sixty-six is a whole year stood edge to edge in the only count that is exact — the month he was born in come round again, a date named to nobody under any roof, no party, no cake, no figure, no recognition, no threshold crossed and nobody who would know what a number counts. The boy keeps it exactly and does not stand it up as a line; the house keeps its days in loaves, glances and weather and cannot say a year has turned. The carried fire's fifth is unpaid 366 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name is unspoken 366 days (T009/T013/T092). Body inventoried in the surgeon's old order with the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed and neither verdict: leathery crust two inches off with corner a hair off the wool and empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, turns them with a broken pot's back, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look (T058/T079, T100, T077, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086). The widow's mark hangs untouched — a morning is not an opening, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, no eighth made due. Carry forward unchanged and unspent: 306 honest answers; six hearings with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told, four, four and a gap; nine hands with no tenth (Ilva's ninth offstage, Hessa's eighth offstage); nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with pot-crack resting beside, hand-at-sill breath beside that, holding of Ash 26 beside all and setting-down-wrong beside the premature Smoke 14 note, none a sixth, seventh or eighth; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, well-saying four shapings, row five askings with no witness; Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart; nine arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked and unread in Berr's box, figure read not paid, no signature on the space, no doctrine out of nine; promise under the wheel-shed ungiven and \emph{he's not Vail} sealed. Three counts in three places do not become one. The hand outside the wool takes a small intake, holds it whole on the river's note's own finishing under the ice, comes straight down on answer 307 and is laid back against the fold; nothing crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Last image: the small hand flat again on the wool on answer 307, worth nothing at two inches of air, while the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap and a whole year stands exact where nobody can see it.

scenes.title: The Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 7 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling and two fence-menders. No Ilva (offstage since the well on Stone 4), no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, and no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). **The birthday is spent as an ordinary afternoon:** no recognition under any roof, no boundary drawn, neither habit of naming the months set right or left, and the first completed year is not marked by a look, a word, a figure or a loaf (T071/T072 advanced, not paid). Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair — the gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin on the trough, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet — and the river's winter skin is found where put on its own place beside water-over-water, not a fourth covering, not a sixth low thing, not a hearing and not spent on the birthday or on the Drawing three mornings off (T083/T085, T078). Dressed grain lies covered and unfigured, fingers in and out without closing; the empty fingers are a keeping beside the one object of Bone 22 and not a second handful (T077, T060/T086). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: hare to the weather which carried the snow and can carry the price, cracked jar to a pot that says nothing, woman with kindling asking what the seventh year will want answered with an early thaw and a late to which Tarn says *Yes, house* and keeps the late because it puts off the paying (T077). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting and makes neither again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring catching the little light, stroke over the flagstones without the half-check (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, keeps dusty forearms on one tray and clean on another, parts them as clot from vessel, gives men unnamed in the back room no name and does not say the room is cold, speaks to the wheel before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from a High Kiln master, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites — and takes it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T062/T035/T031); \emph{he's not Vail} stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed, thread left frozen and unwiped, saying nothing. The hand takes its small intake and comes down on answer 308. Last image: the bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf with the crust two inches off and its empty place unnamed, the hand laid back on the fold on answer 308, and the yard's returning-line place still widest of the seven although no day under any roof was set apart for a first year finished.

scenes.title: The Day After the Name Nobody Gave
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{367}{Stone 8, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the morning of the day after the birthday, an ordinary tending day with no market, Cross or bell and no collector or runner. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 308. Count 366 to 367 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-six to one hundred and eighty-seven days told by nobody (T071/T072); carried fire's fifth unpaid 367 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 367 days (T009/T013/T092). **The dramatic purpose is to prove the birthday left no residue:** the house wakes to the same hearth grammar, the same crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, the same frozen thread, the same cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist; nothing under any roof refers to yesterday as a day that was different, and the boy's completed year stays a keeping nobody can be asked about and nobody can join to a figure. Carry forward unchanged and unspent: 308 honest answers on the sixth place; six hearings with seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; nine hands with no tenth, Ilva's strip still in her sleeve offstage and Hessa's writing still unread offstage; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with pot-crack resting, hand-at-sill breath, holding of Ash 26 and setting-down-wrong each on its own place; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, well-saying four shapings, row five askings; Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction apart; river's skin beside water-over-water, not spent on any date; nine arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box and the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down; seven openings in seven months not a rule with the widow's mark untouched at a shelf, a hearth, a morning and a bed and no eighth made due; promise under the wheel-shed ungiven and \emph{he's not Vail} sealed. Sella's hearth grammar renews in full — fire before basket, *The house will keep it*, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs and hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look (T058/T079, T100, T077, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086). The surgeon/infant quarrel is renewed with neither verdict and the surgeon's knowledge that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly stays exact and worth nothing to a body that cannot lift a crust two inches; the three counts stay in three places and do not become one. The hand takes its small intake and comes straight down on answer 309. Last image: the twice-mended pot standing on the pot board with the hairline of its first break showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, and the small hand laid flat again on the fold on answer 309 — the day before already a day nobody named and the year already a whole year nobody counted.

scenes.title: The Iron With Two Bites
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 8 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva, Berr or Hessa on stage, no runner, no collector, no market, Cross or bell, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting and no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). **Dramatic purpose: the quiet danger gathers interest while the household keeps its ordinary afternoon.** Sella goes around the seven places with a look and no number, widest around the returning-line place; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and the river's skin is found where put and not spent on any date; dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful; hunts and repairs stay directions, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085, T077). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb's resting and makes neither again, and brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end — the sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it going to the threshold and no figure or name following it, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the equality under the roof holding at the place it moved to with no payer named, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist catching and giving back what little light there is, stroke over the flagstones without the half-check (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and get no name and no word that the room is cold; he keeps dusty and clean forearms on separate trays and parts them as clot from vessel, asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate while the broken ones lie under the lowest rack and are entered by nobody; speaks to the wheel before any person, tells a pot *You'll do* with no welcome and no unkindness, knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and leaves it standing so the household straightens around the waiting — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — then takes the finger out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, for a second would be a habit and a third a way and both want a payer and none stood (T062/T035/T031). \emph{He's not Vail} stays sealed and the promise of his name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings and the Ash 5, 17 and 23 places held apart, with no witness standing. The boy files the dust, the two bites and the unspent breath on separate places and writes no cause across any of them. The hand comes down on answer 310. Last image: the bent finger taken out of the cold damper without a second interval, the flagstones keeping the place where Tarn's stroke went on without the half-check, and the hand laid back against the fold on answer 310 with the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn.

scenes.title: Three Hundred and Sixty-Eight
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{368}{Stone 9, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the morning of the last day the chapter lives. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 310, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap. Count 367 to 368 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-seven to one hundred and eighty-eight days told by nobody (T071/T072); carried fire's fifth unpaid 368 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 368 days (T009/T013/T092). The completed year stands behind the boy and is not stood up as a threshold, a doctrine, a figure or a line crossed; the house keeps its days in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces and cannot say what a year would count. Carry forward unchanged and unspent: 310 honest answers on the sixth place; six hearings with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told, four, four and a gap; told figure beside paid with no signature on the space and no doctrine standing up out of nine; nine hands with no tenth (Ilva's ninth, Hessa's eighth, both offstage); nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with pot-crack resting, hand-at-sill breath, holding of Ash 26 and setting-down-wrong beside the premature Smoke 14 note, each found where put and not made again; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, well-saying four shapings, row five askings with no witness; Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart; river's skin beside water-over-water, not spent on the birthday, this morning or the Drawing; widow's mark untouched since Stone 5, seven openings in seven months not a rule and no eighth made due; promise under the wheel-shed ungiven. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: crust two inches off with empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek temple and bare wrist-joint, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella's hearth grammar renews in full with fire before basket, *The house will keep it*, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the shelf with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look (T058/T079, T100, T077, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086). Three counts in three places do not become one and the bell's gap stays in its square. The hand takes a small intake, holds it whole on the note's own finishing under the ice, comes straight down on answer 311 and is laid back against the fold. Last image: the boards overhead keeping four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not, while the small hand lies flat on the fold on answer 311 and three hundred and sixty-eight stands exact one morning from Stone 10.

scenes.title: The Borrowed Inch
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 9 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven places with a look and no number and widest around the returning-line place, sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed, leaves the thread frozen and unwiped, and says nothing of where they have been (T009/T013/T092, T098, T060/T086). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, river's skin found where put and not made again and not spent on any date; dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful; hunts and repairs as directions (T083/T085, T077). Tarn at the kindling keeps six and the seventh, checks the held breath and the thumb's resting and makes neither again, stops the ear-sentence at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person, withholds the full note, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes it out without a second interval (T062/T035/T031); \emph{he's not Vail} stays sealed and the promise ungiven. At the going of the light the hearth grammar renews in full and the twice-mended pot keeps its hairline showing with both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person; repair stays apart from restoration. In the small hours the surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not the same as peace; under the roof the room holds its small sounds — the dry rasp of a coal settling under ash, the small tick of cooling clay along the shelf, the river's note low under its winter skin through the finger's-width door, the roof's own silence which is not the absence of sound but the sound of a house holding itself level. Three hundred and sixty-eight stands exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-eight days told by nobody, a whole year finished and still not named; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092). The file comes out on the towel as instruments come out on a towel and he goes over it by the place of each thing: **three hundred and twelve honest answers** on the sixth place after answer 312, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; nine hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth; five held objects with pot-crack resting, hand-at-sill breath, holding of Ash 26 and setting-down-wrong each on its own place beside the premature Smoke 14 note; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, well-saying four shapings, row five askings with no witness; Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction apart; nine arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked and unread in Berr's box up the clay road and no signature on the space; the river's skin beside water-over-water; promise under the wheel-shed ungiven. Three counts stay in three places and are not one. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping is invented to make a row come out even; a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the ice, lets it go and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer **312**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082). Last image: the hand flat against the fold on answer 312 and the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river low over lower under its winter skin through the finger's-width door, the boards keeping four, four and a thumb-width knot, the crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third — and Stone 9 done with the deep-winter month holding, forward not closed.
